space.$description: Seven steps, each double the previous. Covers margin, padding, gap and offsets.

100.$description: Inside a component: icon to label, tag padding.

200.$description: Between siblings: rows, list items, panel padding.

500.$description: Large layout: space around a hero or a page opening.

600.$description: Large layout: offsets on wide marketing pages.

700.$description: Large layout: the largest offset on wide marketing pages.

100.$description: Controls: buttons, inputs, selects, tabs, nav items.

300.$description: Large surfaces: cards that stand alone, dialogs.

400.$description: The largest surfaces: sheets, hero blocks.

width.$description: Fixed widths for a field or a block, used through the width helpers (eis-width-*). In a row of fields they are the base and the minimum width of a field, which grows into the free room.

100.$description: A short value: a number, a date, a status select.

200.$description: A word or two: a type, a name.

300.$description: A short line: a title, an e-mail.

100.$description: The only line weight. Hairlines separate; boxes are the exception.
